esports.description: Markets resolved by recorded esports match, map, tournament, roster, or event outcomes where the settlement source should be an official tournament, organizer, league, game publisher, or recognized match data page.
expected_resolution_source_types: official league or organizer results page
recognized match statistics page when official source is unavailable
common_resolution_risks: forfeit or technical default wording differs from scoreboard wording
map count and match winner markets can use different settlement clauses
event pages may update after disputes or reschedules
team names, aliases, and roster labels may differ across sources
best-of format or included maps may be unclear
operator_review_focus: confirm the market wording matches the exact match, map, team, and event
check whether forfeits, postponements, or map replays have special handling
verify official source identity and timestamp
record any mismatch between source names and market names
keep the capture as draft until direct operator review is complete
future_read_only_fetch_requirements: future fetch must be public and unauthenticated
future fetch must write raw source artifacts only
future fetch must record source URL or source label and retrieval timestamp
future fetch must not mutate canonical packets or capture templates directly
future fetch requires a separate task with explicit network approval

weather.description: Markets resolved by weather observations, measurements, warnings, or station reports where the settlement source should be an official meteorological agency, station, or published dataset named by the market.
expected_resolution_source_types: national or regional meteorological agency page
official climate or daily summary dataset
common_resolution_risks: station identity, timezone, and observation window may be ambiguous
measurement units and rounding rules may differ from market wording
local time and UTC windows may not match
nearby stations may be mistaken for the named settlement station
operator_review_focus: confirm the location, station, measurement type, units, and time window
check whether preliminary data can later be revised
verify local timezone handling against market wording
record any station substitutions or missing source details
keep the capture as draft until direct operator review is complete
future_read_only_fetch_requirements: future fetch must be public and unauthenticated
future fetch must write raw source artifacts only
future fetch must preserve agency or station identifiers
future fetch must record retrieval timestamp and observed source timestamp when available
future fetch requires a separate task with explicit network approval

crypto.description: Markets resolved by cryptocurrency price, index, chain event, ETF, or exchange-published event wording where the settlement source should be the named index, exchange, chain explorer, issuer page, or official market rules text.
expected_resolution_source_types: official chain explorer or protocol page
ETF issuer or regulatory filing page when named by the market
Polymarket rules text for exact settlement source naming
common_resolution_risks: price source, cutoff time, and timezone may be unclear
index methodologies can use different aggregation windows
chain reorganizations or delayed data can affect event timing
ticker symbols may refer to multiple assets or venues
market wording may depend on a named source rather than a generic price
operator_review_focus: confirm the named source, asset identifier, measurement window, and units
check whether the market depends on a specific index methodology
record any ambiguity in ticker or venue naming
keep the capture as draft until direct operator review is complete
future_read_only_fetch_requirements: future fetch must be public and unauthenticated
future fetch must write raw source artifacts only
future fetch must preserve named source and timestamp metadata
future fetch must not derive market actions or mutate runtime state
future fetch requires a separate task with explicit network approval
